description: Change history for the docs overhaul and /api/products, added as sections in existing docs (no CHANGELOG.md). Full spec and the commit-to-doc source table: tasks/prd-change-history.md (read it before each story). Docs-only: no code changes. Typecheck = `cd frontend && npm run check`. One commit per story: `docs: US-0XX - <title>`. Never write tests that check docs against code.

userStories.title: Change-history summary in the docs index
userStories.description: As a developer returning to the repo, I want one list of what changed on this branch so that I know which differences from the old code are intended.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/README.md gets a `## Change history` section at the end with a `### 2026-10-17 — docs overhaul and /api/products` subsection
The subsection has three groups in this order: Breaking / behaviour changes, Removed, Documentation-only

Every row of the 'Source of truth' table in tasks/prd-change-history.md is covered; each bullet is one sentence, names its commit hash (checked with `git show <hash>`) and links to the owning doc section with a relative markdown link
Links into FALCON_API_CONTRACT.md use the section numbers after the US-002 renumbering

'Removed' names exactly: `--no-sqlite-readonly`, `SQLITE_DB_PATH`, `SQLITE_READ_ONLY`, `SQLITE_JOURNAL_MODE`, `SQLITE_SYNCHRONOUS`, `SQLITE_URI`, `INFLATION_DATA_ROOT`, `inflation_dashboard/adapters/csv_price_repository.py`, `SUPPORTED_RETAILERS`, the `scripts/verify_redis_store.py` CI step, `docs/SEPARATION.md` (moved to docs/archive/), `docs/CONVENTIONS.md`/`docs/CONCERNS.md` content (moved to ARCHITECTURE.md)
States that US-018 (Svelte @component blocks) was deferred and is not part of this change
Every relative link and anchor in the new section resolves (checked by hand with the link-check one-liner in progress.txt)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: API contract version, renumbering and changes section
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I want the contract to say what changed between versions so that I can update a client.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/FALCON_API_CONTRACT.md header: Specification Version `2.2.0`, Last Updated set to the date of this change
Endpoint sections are renumbered in order: `/api/products` (currently §4.7a) becomes §4.7, and `/api/products/search`, `/api/product`, `/api/epeykatfg/monthly-inflation` become §4.8, §4.9, §4.10
Every in-file § reference (e.g. 'The response shape is in §4.7', '§4.7a') and every inbound reference from other docs (grep `4.7`, `4.8`, `4.9` in docs/ and frontend/README.md) uses the new numbers

A new `## 9. Changes` section lists per version (2.2.0, then 2.1.0) the client-visible changes: new `/api/products`; `/api/health` `data.database`; 503 `database_unavailable`; envelopes for 404/405/500; fixed `server_error` message `Internal server error`; warning text `all_history requested; history load is uncapped`; default retailers Gurmar/Vakko/HomeGoods. Each item links to its section
No endpoint behaviour text changes other than the section numbers
§6.2 is still identical to frontend/src/lib/types/api.ts (diff command in progress.txt)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 'Changed' notes in configuration and data docs
userStories.description: As an operator upgrading an existing deployment, I want each changed variable or flag flagged where it is documented so that I don't keep using a removed one.
acceptanceCriteria: Notes use the exact form `> **Changed 2026-10-17:** <what changed>; previously <old behaviour>. See [change history](README.md#change-history).` (adjust the relative path per file)

docs/CONFIGURATION.md § Launcher flags: note that `--sqlite-db` now defaults to `PRICES_DB_PATH` (previously the launcher overwrote it) and that `--no-sqlite-readonly` and the five `SQLITE_*` exports were removed
docs/CONFIGURATION.md § API and data variables: note that `INFLATION_DATA_ROOT` was removed
docs/CONFIGURATION.md § Frontend: note that an empty `VITE_API_BASE_URL` now means same origin (previously `http://localhost:8000`)
docs/DATABASE.md § Purpose: note that the runtime CSV fallback was removed and a missing database returns 503 (previously the API fell back to CSV, which found no files in the committed layout)
docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md § Ownership: note that `data/raw` is no longer read at runtime
Each note is one or two sentences; no existing current-behaviour text is rewritten
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 'Changed' notes in frontend and user docs
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I want the frontend docs to flag the changed defaults and the new product-list request so that I understand why the code differs from older branches.
acceptanceCriteria: Notes use the same `> **Changed 2026-10-17:** …` form as US-003 and link to docs/README.md#change-history
frontend/README.md § API URL: note that the default changed to same origin (previously `http://localhost:8000`)

frontend/README.md § Views: note that the Product explorer pickers now use `/api/products` (previously the full `/api/history`, which failed for large categories with 'API response from /api/history was not valid JSON')
docs/USER_GUIDE.md § 1. Product price explorer: add only the 'Changed' note; do not change the behaviour text
Typecheck passes

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: the Product explorer pickers load for the default Markets category with no 'not valid JSON' error. If the skill is unavailable, record this as unverified in notes
